IMPLEMENTATION.description: First draft-contract increment only. Actual publisher integration, campaign assets/rendering, channel admission, observation/corrections and metrics templates remain pending. Partial checks cannot satisfy whole acceptance. Event adapter/kit progress is recorded separately; original full article campaign, channel admission and observed publication history remain unfinished.

INDEPENDENT-REVIEW.description: Required independent/editorial review of implemented behavior and applicable CS01-CS10; preparation self-review is not independent acceptance.

MERGE.description: Normal maintainer merge decision after complete issue acceptance; campaign readiness cannot block the separate article publication in PR79.

PLAN-REVIEW.description: Verify the actual linked issue/PR and versioned approved scope, source reference, relative schedule and explicit nonblocking separation from PR79. This is plan review, not campaign implementation.
